---
title: "simstim host destroy"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Delete a host made by `host create`: its VM, container or sandbox, and every session on it.

```text
simstim host destroy <name> [flags]
```

Delete the machine behind a host, then forget the host. It asks first, and refuses while a session is working unless you pass `--force`.

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | destroy it even while a session is working |
| `-y`, `--yes` | do not ask first |

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
